name: Elizabeth Thompson
bioAdditions: Pelletreau's Appendix states that Job Smith 'married Elizabeth, daughter of John Thompson, Esq., of Setauket' and lists her seven children (S1). Weygant (1897) repeats this but adds the now-disproven Mayflower Brewster mother and Rev. William Thompson grandfather (S2).

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau, Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix pp. 478-479, 'Descendants of Job Smith, Son of the Patentee' and 'Descendants of James Smith, Son of Job, 1st' (full text read on archive.org)
sources.supports: Elizabeth dau. of John Thompson of Setauket, wife of Job Smith

sources.citation: C. H. Weygant, The Family Record (1897; devoted to the Sackett, Weygant and Mapes families and intersecting lines), pp. 144-145, 'Smiths of Smithtown', Generations III-V
sources.supports: repeats the disproven Brewster/Rev. William Thompson ancestry

researchLogEntry: Round 4: Pelletreau Appendix restates her parentage; Weygant repeats the disproven Brewster claim.
